title: Window Hopper - Support secondary key combination (alternate keyboard language)
author: Robertm0

status.label: design investigation in progress
status.detail: Current Window Hopper registers only one next and one previous hotkey rather than alternate bindings for different layouts.

next_action.label: Complete implementation-grade design
next_action.reason: No approve_design action until storage, registration, validation, and tests converge.

judgment.rationale: The request is a bounded configuration/runtime extension, and current Window Hopper registers only one next and one previous hotkey rather than alternate bindings.
evidence: The user provides a concrete US/UK layout-switching scenario.
AltWindowCycle stores only next_window_shortcut and previous_window_shortcut.
get_hotkeys exposes exactly two registrations: next and previous.
No duplicate or owner was found.
judgment.recommended_action: Continue full design work covering alternate binding storage, registration, validation, and release semantics; do not expose approve_design yet.

issue_context.summary: Window Hopper’s configured grave-key shortcut does not remain usable when switching keyboard layouts, so the user requests an alternate activation combination.
known_information: The issue identifies the two layouts and Keyboard Manager validation failures encountered as a workaround.
Current Window Hopper settings define one next and one previous shortcut.
The module registers a fixed HotkeyCount of two.
inferences: Supporting aliases may require more runner hotkey registrations while preserving which modifier release commits the overlay.
issue_context.analysis: The feature is narrow enough to design, but implementation details and tests are not yet complete enough for approval.
initial_investigation: Reviewed AltWindowCycle/dllmain.cpp settings parsing, default VK_OEM_3 binding, registration, and modifier handling.
Searched live issues and found no matching alternate-layout tracker.

information_gaps.information: Exact representation and conflict policy for alternate bindings
information_gaps.why_needed: Required for an implementation-grade design compatible with existing settings and runner registration.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Resolve in full design by tracing Settings UI models, JSON migration, and global hotkey conflict handling.
